title: Basket Discount Calculator
summary: Enter unit price in cents, quantity, and discount percentage; the total rounds down once to whole cents. Example: 1299 cents × 3 at 10% off = 3507 cents.

draft_review.summary: The calculator is bounded and understandable: it accepts a unit price in cents, quantity, and discount percentage, then rounds the total down once to whole cents. The arithmetic source uses only the allowed inputs and operations, and all supplied machine checks and 17 independent fixtures pass. The evidence supports that it is runnable; I did not run it myself.
draft_review.improvement: Add a worked example to the summary, such as 1299 cents × 3 at 10% off = 3507 cents, so customers can quickly verify the result.

final_review.summary: The calculator is bounded, understandable, and supported as runnable by the supplied machine checks and 17 independent fixtures. Its source uses permitted arithmetic, its inputs and labels match the checkout chore, and the worked example is correct: 1299 × 3 × 90% = 3507 cents. I did not run it myself.
final_review.improvement: Add a brief note that the calculation applies the discount to the combined basket and rounds down once at the end, so customers know how fractional cents are handled.
